name: ring iron
enchant_note: Cold iron turns magic aside: it holds very little.
protection_note: Plain wrought iron, the cold iron of the old stories: the fair folk will not touch it.
protection_price: It conducts lightning, and it rusts.
lore_descriptor: dull gray iron, spotted here and there with rust
first_pickup_chronicle: Found an iron ring shirt, cold-riveted. Should turn a blade.
